Bart Verbruggen.note: Verbruggen's signature is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Bart Verbruggen.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Brian Brobbey.note: Watch Brobbey for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Brian Brobbey.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Cody Gakpo.note: Watch Gakpo for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Cody Gakpo.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Crysencio Summerville.note: Summerville is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Crysencio Summerville.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Denzel Dumfries.note: Dumfries is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Denzel Dumfries.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Donyell Malen.note: Malen's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Donyell Malen.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Frenkie de Jong.note: Jong is defined by keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Frenkie de Jong.noteZh: 他靠压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Guus Til.note: Til stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Guus Til.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Jan Paul van Hecke.note: Hecke stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Jan Paul van Hecke.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Jorrel Hato.note: Hato's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Jorrel Hato.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Justin Kluivert.note: Kluivert stands out for carrying momentum through open midfield. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Justin Kluivert.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Lutsharel Geertruida.note: Geertruida's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Lutsharel Geertruida.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mark Flekken.note: Flekken is defined by turning a save into the first pass of an attack. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Mark Flekken.noteZh: 他靠把一次扑救变成进攻第一传与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Marten de Roon.note: Roon's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Marten de Roon.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Mats Wieffer.note: Wieffer's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Mats Wieffer.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Memphis Depay.note: Depay is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Memphis Depay.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Micky van de Ven.note: Ven stands out for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Micky van de Ven.noteZh: 他的突出特点是防线暴露后的回追速度。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Nathan Ake.note: Aké's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Nathan Ake.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Noa Lang.note: Lang's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Noa Lang.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Quinten Timber.note: Timber's edge is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Quinten Timber.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Robin Roefs.note: Watch Roefs for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements.
Robin Roefs.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。

Ryan Gravenberch.note: Watch Gravenberch for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ryan Gravenberch.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Teun Koopmeiners.note: Koopmeiners's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Teun Koopmeiners.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用传球的力度和角度移动防线上。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Tijjani Reijnders.note: Reijnders stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Tijjani Reijnders.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Virgil van Dijk.note: Dijk's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Virgil van Dijk.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Wout Weghorst.note: Weghorst is defined by making purposeful movement away from the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Wout Weghorst.noteZh: 他靠用有目的的无球移动创造接应点与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。
